theory.title: Exercise 4.2.3: Case Conversion
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Case sensitivity causes bugs. User enters 'Admin' but system expects 'admin'—login fails. Convert to consistent case before comparison to avoid these issues."

Case Conversion Keywords

Normalize text case:

Library    String

${text}=    Set Variable    Hello World
${lower}=    Convert To Lower Case    ${text}
# Result: 'hello world'

${upper}=    Convert To Upper Case    ${text}
# Result: 'HELLO WORLD'

${title}=    Convert To Title Case    ${text}
# Result: 'Hello World'

When to Use:

  • Search: Convert search term and target to same case
  • Comparison: Normalize before equals check
  • Validation: Ensure consistent format
  • Display: Format for presentation

Example: Case-Insensitive Search

*** Settings ***
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
Find System
    ${search}=    Set Variable    POWER
    @{systems}=    Create List    Navigation    Power    Engines
    FOR    ${system}    IN    @{systems}
        ${system_lower}=    Convert To Lower Case    ${system}
        ${search_lower}=    Convert To Lower Case    ${search}
        IF    '${system_lower}' == '${search_lower}'
            Log    Found: ${system}
            BREAK
        END
    END

⚠️ Case Conversion Tips

  • Returns new string (original unchanged)
  • Convert To Title Case: First Letter Uppercase
  • Use before comparison for case-insensitive matching
  • Consider performance: convert once, reuse result
  • Alternative: use case_insensitive flag in Should Be Equal
